description: One unload (ADR-0009): the model's unload_skill call for a loaded skill, the skill_unloaded event between the call and its result (the skill's id), and the result. The skill's block leaves every later request; the skill stays catalogued, and loading it again counts as another load. Written by hand; skills.test.ts and go/context hold SkillGate to each.
